config.abstention: a *_calibrated system answers only when its calibrated top probability is at least the abstain threshold; the other systems answer every photo. Where the calibration file has a healthy_threshold (T4.9's refit, for the primary and its quantized copy) the metrics named coverage@T~H, selective_accuracy@T~H and confident_error_rate@T~H apply what Identifier serves, a top label ending in 'healthy' must also reach max(T, H), through sprout.serve.calibrate.answered_mask; the metrics named @T are abstention alone, so the cost of the healthy bar in unsure answers is the difference. E4's and E12's files define no healthy threshold, so those alternates use abstention alone.
